items.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was that the event that honored Carole King? [INTERVIEWEE] No. I think it was organized for the Monk Institute.

ctx.x: will be at the Kennedy Center behind the real deal. That was one day that I said, “Well, Ada you didn’t mess up too much in your life.”
Was that the event that honored Carole King?

No. I think it was organized for the Monk Institute. It was something like that. And we were asked — you know I was one of the guests and was supposed to play the day after — we arrived early the day before to do rehearsal and like out of nowhere they asked will you be willing to be in the horn section with Aretha Franklin and I was like uh yes! Look at me. I was thrilled. And I mean that’s massive. You know it’s funny because the same night we had performed also with Herbie Hancock and a bunch of other…
